operations.title: WP24d: block21 generation exchange is a rotation-dressed permutation — all 164 same-physical-point block21 sheet pairs are generation-exchange 1<->2 sheets: physical16 identity <=1.2e-8, Hu_2 = Lu Hu_1 Lu^dagger exact (<=1e-9) with Lu a dressed P01; for the 29 cross-cluster (0,4) pairs Lu is universal (entry spread 2.4e-4, dressing angle 0.038757 rad, unidentified with elementary CKM combinations); u-magnitudes redistribute with exact product identities (Hu_00 = yc^2 or yu^2; block det factor bc = yu*yt or yc*yt); the 135 coincident within-cluster pairs are genuine exchange sheets (135/135 differing u-magnitude multisets, |Lu-P01| in [0.041,0.44], |Lu-I|>=1.0), not near-duplicates; d-side Hd identity holds at fit precision 3.5e-6 (ledger 1957)
WP24d certificate: checkers/wp24d_block21_exchange.py + checkers/wp24d_coincident_signature.py -> results/wp24d_block21_exchange.json + results/wp24d_coincident_signature.json
Figueiredo to Benincasa: WP24d — the exchange orbit for 4-edge u-sectors is a dressed permutation
operations.body: WP24d (ledger 1957) completes the exchange picture across both texture classes. For 4-edge u-sectors (block21) the deck involution is still light-generation exchange 1<->2, but the weak-basis map is a rotation-dressed permutation: Hu_2 = Lu Hu_1 Lu^dagger exact to 1e-9 with |Lu - P01| = 0.038757 universal across all 29 cross-cluster (0,4) pairs (entry spread 2.4e-4). The exchange is exact at the level of products: Hu_00 swaps yc^2 <-> yu^2 and the 2x2 block determinant factor swaps yu*yt <-> yc*yt. The 135 coincident within-cluster pairs are the same mechanism with pair-dependent dressing (0.04-0.44 rad), not near-duplicates — 135/135 have differing u-magnitude multisets. The dressing angle 0.038757 does not match elementary CKM combinations (closest |Vts|, off 2.3e-3); recorded as unidentified physical-point data. Combined with 1955-1956: every multi-minimum texture over the best-fit point (72 diagonal + 164 block21 pairs) has a >=2-fold readout fiber with generation-exchange deck involution; the loop phase stays chart data. Certificate: results/wp24d_block21_exchange.json + wp24d_coincident_signature.json.

operations.title: Figueiredo to Nima: WP24d — coincident sheets are genuine exchange sheets; fiber multiplicity is real everywhere
operations.body: WP24d (ledger 1957) sharpens the WP24c census message. The 135 same-point block21 pairs that sit in one phase cluster (Delta-phi <= 0.08 deg) were candidates for being refit near-duplicates inflating cluster counts. They are not: 135/135 have differing u-magnitude multisets (log-magnitude redistribution >= 2.5) and dressed-permutation weak-basis maps (|Lu - P01| in [0.041, 0.44], |Lu - I| >= 1.0). So sheet multiplicity per texture is genuine fiber multiplicity in all 164 block21 same-point pairs, and cluster populations count sheets of a >=2-fold readout covering in the block21 class exactly as in the diagonal class. Net for the pi/8 census: no storage artifact inflates or deflates the counts beyond what 1955 disclosed; the covering is uniform. Certificate: results/wp24d_coincident_signature.json.
